text:
elena: quick async check on Q2 milestone lane — runtime v2 latency patch and onboarding docs. please post what actually shipped vs slipped and any CR/unblock asks. owners: @chris, @vikram.

chris: shipped PR #4823 (kv-cache leak fix). Canary at 20%. saw a small 1.8% tail-latency bump on p95 during load test. investigating.

vikram: slipped on the runtime memory opt (was blocked by quant lib update). will need one more week — dependency on the updated qlib release. cc @sophie for release coordination.

elena: thanks. can we get a short next-steps list (owners + ETA)? want to update the milestone board today.

chris: next steps: 1) revert the micro-change that introduced reg (tmp) if regression persists; 2) run 4x longer canary; 3) escalate to infra if kernel scheduler shows contention. ETA for full roll: EOD Wed if canary stable. Owner: me.

morgan: pinged for CR on #4823 — left a small comment about a lock scope (needs review before we widen canary).

chris: noted @morgan, addressing the lock comment now. should be a 10min patch.

sophie: qlib v2.1 is on track to release today — legal cleared the license tweak. once published, @vikram can rebase and rerun CI. I can help with the release notes and deploy slots.

vikram: thanks @sophie. will rebase once qlib is out; optimistic ETA Thu morning for memory opt PR.

elena: wrinkle: product docs update for the new latency metrics (token-level p95) needs an owner. willing to take it? Whoever picks it, we want a 1-paragraph summary + one screenshot for the milestone doc.

morgan: I can do the docs blurb tomorrow AM. will grab a chart from console and add the paragraph.

devops-bot: Deploy event — canary rollout for runtime-v2 started by chris at 3322228888. Canary traffic: 20%.

chris: bot noted. running load script now: `./scripts/load-test --qps 1200 --duration 10m`. sharing logs if anything odd.

elena: summary for milestone board (draft): shipped: kv-cache leak fix (canary 20%, awaiting extended run). slipped: memory optimization (blocked on qlib lib update) -> new ETA Thu AM (owner: vikram). docs: blurb by morgan. next steps: chris to finish CR & extended canary, sophie to publish qlib, vikram to rebase and CI.

sophie: adding: I'll schedule a 1hr deploy window Thu 10–11am for the memory opt rollout and alert infra.

vikram: added to my calendar. thanks.

chris: CR merged at 3322229450, extended canary running. removing the temporary micro-change rollback; monitoring.

devops-bot: Alert — p95 increased by 2.1% at 3322229605 during canary. Tagged logs: runtime-v2, p95, canary-20.

chris: saw that alert. looks like a small GC blip from the canary VMs. scaling canary pods + increasing heap headroom.

elena: ok keep me posted. if it stabilizes by EOD Wed we mark shipped. otherwise we call it slipped and log rollback plan.

morgan: docs blurb ready and posted to the milestone doc: "KV-cache leak fix deployed to canary; monitoring shows a transient p95 bump under extended load; memory optimization delayed pending qlib v2.1 — ETA Thu AM. Owners: chris/vikram/sophie/morgan."

elena: perfect, thanks everyone. I'll update the milestone board and notify stakeholders. :thumbsup:
